dedupe_keys.name: goiener smart meter data hourly electricity consumption of 25 559 spanish supply points 2014 2022

description: This data set holds hourly electricity consumption in kilowatt hours for the customers of GoiEner, a renewable energy retail cooperative founded in 2012 in the Basque Country, published on Zenodo by GoiEner and the University of Deusto within the EU Horizon 2020 WHY project. The Scientific Data descriptor reports 25,559 anonymised raw hourly series from supply points that are mainly homes but also shops, offices, industrial plants and public facilities, with an average length of nearly three years between November 2014 and June 2022. Beside the raw file, three cleaned subsets with imputed gaps cover the periods before, during and after the COVID-19 lockdowns, and a metadata file gives each series with its dates, length, missing samples and economic activity code. Coverage is all provinces of peninsular Spain, with most points in the Basque Country and Navarre. Files are CSV inside compressed archives, free to download; DataCite lists CC BY 4.0 while the Zenodo description text says CC-BY-SA, so users should check the terms. Caveats: smart meters were not widespread in Spain before 2018, so early years have few series, and customers are those of one cooperative. Simulation uses are household and sector load profiles for distribution planning, demand response under lockdowns and pricing changes, and agent-based demand models. Related records: data-elmas-french-industrial-tertiary-load-profiles gives French sector load profiles.
